commands: Remove-Item Env:GITHUB_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:GH_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git fetch origin agent/tag-library-backup; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git reset --hard origin/agent/tag-library-backup; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}

$payload = Get-Content public/data/sexual-tags.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ('SEX_TAG_COUNT=' + $payload.tags.Count); Write-Host ('MIN_POST_COUNT=' + $payload.minPostCount); if($payload.minPostCount -ne 1000){throw 'Unexpected Sex tag threshold'}; if($payload.tags.Count -lt 200 -or $payload.tags.Count -gt 400){throw 'Unexpected curated Sex tag count'}
git config --local --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader 2>$null; gh auth setup-git; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}

git add public/data/sexual-tags.json; if(git diff --cached --quiet){Write-Host 'NO_DATA_CHANGE'; exit 0}; git commit -m 'Curate and group Danbooru sexual tags'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git push origin HEAD:agent/tag-library-backup; exit $LASTEXITCODE
